  AI for Medical Image Analysis [CSE-4011]  
Marks: 50                                                                              Duration: 180 mins.

Answer all the questions.

2)           Describe the main steps in Mahapatra et al.'s active learning process for image  
  segmentation, including how the initial model is trained, how uncertainty and diversity  
  guide sample selection, and how a conditional GAN is used to enhance the labelled           (4)  
  A)      dataset before retraining.  
  
  B)      Analyse the importance of annotated imaging datasets in building effective machine  
  learning models for radiology, and explore the factors that influence their reliability and (3)  
  availability.  
  
  C)      Analyse the role of intensity comparisons in the BRIEF descriptor and explain how they  
  contribute to efficient keypoint matching.                                             (3)  
  
3)           How can domain knowledge about boundary appearance be applied to improve the  
  segmentation of a foreground object with unclear boundaries in an ultrasound image  
  using methods such as active contours or level sets?                                        (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Apply the concept of temporal continuity to describe how you would segment a 4D  
  (3D+ Time) MRI heart sequence consistently across multiple time steps.                      (5)  
  
4)                                                                                                       (5)

Analyse how the use of both spatial and contextual encoding paths in the Dual Encoding  
  U-Net architecture enables the model to balance local detail preservation with global  
  A)         context understanding for effective retinal vessel segmentation.  
  
  B)         Analyse how the initial low-resolution classification step in the coarse-to-fine ML-  
  assisted tumour detection pipeline contributes to the overall efficiency of the framework. (5)  
  Why is it critical to the system's performance?  
  
5)              Analyse the architectural differences between TensorFlow and Caffe and discuss how  
  these differences impact their use in designing deep learning models for medical image  
  segmentation.                                                                              (5)
